covered_projection: Strict byte comparison of ActionFuncLink::apply's funcLinkInput-visible mutations for four calls under the locked x86-64 GCC default model in one Architecture: a locked seven-int8 signature spanning six register parameters and the first stack parameter, a locked six-int8 register-only signature, the seven-int8 locked signature with varargs, and an unlocked signature. This is a coarse (AddressSpace enum, offset, size) projection, not a claim that Rugra Address identity is equivalent to Ghidra AddrSpace* identity.

rugra_base.snapshot_policy: Archive the explicit Cargo/source closure from the pinned base, then overlay the nine hash-pinned live Rust source files and this Rust fixture. No unlisted working-tree file enters the comparand.

architecture.ghidra_loader: BfdArchitecture over the freshly linked C++ fixture executable plus the pinned production specification set
architecture.rugra_loader: Production SleighCtx register table plus Architecture::parse_compiler_config over the identical cspec bytes
architecture.scope: Exactly one Architecture instance per runtime. Multi-Architecture, overlay-space, and cross-thread SpaceTag identity are not tested.

compiler_spec.parameter_assignment: Each runtime asks its production model to assign storage for seven signed eight-byte scalar inputs. No ABI register or stack offset is hard-coded by the fixture.
compiler_spec.observed_storage_shape: Six register parameters followed by the first stack parameter.

analysis_options.entry: One production ActionFuncLink::apply invocation over each synthetic Funcdata containing exactly one CPUI_CALL and one FuncCallSpecs.
analysis_options.normalization: None. Every emitted byte, record order, full coarse space descriptor, offset, size, flag, slot, fixed position, placeholder index, unique offset, object-alias boolean, and bank order is compared directly. Process-local pointer values are not emitted.

input_cases.prototype: seven int8 inputs, non-varargs, input locked
input_cases.expected_path: Permanent active trials and CALL inputs for all formals; the first stack LOAD output becomes the natural placeholder and suppresses a synthetic placeholder.

input_cases.prototype: six int8 register inputs, non-varargs, input locked
input_cases.expected_path: Permanent trials remain inactive with maxpass 0; because no locked stack formal suppresses it, a trailing one-byte synthetic stack placeholder is appended to the CALL while the inactive ParamActive placeholder remains -1.

input_cases.prototype: seven int8 inputs, firstVarArgSlot=2, input locked
input_cases.expected_path: Input recovery becomes active with maxpass 3; fixed positions are 0..6; the stack formal is not the placeholder and a one-byte synthetic stack placeholder is appended.

input_cases.prototype: model-bound but no fixed input parameters
input_cases.expected_path: Input and output recovery become active, no trials are registered, and a synthetic stack placeholder is input slot 1.

input_cases.prototype: standalone ParamActive with one trial before and one trial after setPlaceholderSlot
input_cases.expected_path: getTrialForInputVarnode subtracts the target input and the preceding placeholder exactly as fspec.hh specifies.

observation_schema.case_state: Model, lock/varargs flags, input/output active flags, trial count, pass/maxpass, fully-checked/final-check/recover-subcall/join-reverse, both placeholder slots, and CALL input count.
observation_schema.trial_state: Registration order, coarse space name/index/type, offset, size, CALL slot, packed flags, and fixed position.
observation_schema.call_inputs: Input order, full coarse location, size, annotation/input/written/spacebase-placeholder flags, and defining opcode.
observation_schema.formal_aliases: Formal versus trial and formal versus CALL input coarse space and offset equality. These are not Rust Address::operator== identity claims.
observation_schema.bank_aliases: An ordinary VarnodeBank::create_with_space seed at the first formal's storage is compared with the Action-created CALL input by object identity, coarse location, exact-range count, and location-tree order.
observation_schema.mapping: getTrialForInputVarnode result indices for all registered CALL slots plus the explicit after-placeholder boundary.

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: Ghidra FuncCallSpecs owns an embedded ParamActive and points to its CALL; Rugra owns the callspec behind Arc<RwLock<_>> and mutates the same bank/op objects. The fixture observes the caller-owned trials, callspec flags, CALL inputs, VarnodeBank objects, and placeholder slots after apply.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: ActionFuncLink::apply traverses calls from index 0 to numCalls-1. funcLinkInput traverses locked formals from index 0 to numParams-1 and appends each input in formal order. The fixture uses one call per Funcdata and prints all trials and inputs without sorting or normalization.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: ParamActive begins slotbase=1, stackplaceholder=-1, numpasses=0, maxpass=0. Each registerTrial consumes one slot; setPlaceholderSlot consumes one additional slot. initActiveInput clamps any positive model delay to maxpass=3. Varargs fixed positions are assigned from the zero-based formal index.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: funcLinkInput performs no sort. ParamTrial registration order is formal order; VarnodeBank exact-location order is the production location-tree order. The fixture checks that the preexisting seed is first and the Action-created same-location input is last.

residuals.detail: The Ghidra side compares complete Address values carrying Architecture-owned AddrSpace pointers. The Rust fixture deliberately compares the production split AddressSpace enum plus offset because formal/trial/CALL storage is not uniformly represented by the same tagged Address object. It therefore cannot prove full Address identity, cross-Architecture isolation, overlay identity, or cross-thread SpaceTag behavior.

The ordinary explicit-space bank seed proves only same-side coarse location order and selected object-alias observations. It does not prove the complete VarnodeBank canonical-address, lookup, xref, overlay, or cross-Architecture identity contract for every varnode construction path.

Rugra's generic Funcdata::new_varnode and VarnodeBank::create paths still default spaceless Address storage to RAM, and new_varnode_in_space does not prove the full Ghidra newVarnode localmap queryProperties/setSymbolProperties/property-tail contract. This fixture checks the Action-specific explicit-space path, basic flags, and location-bank ordering only; SymbolEntry/high/property wiring remains outside the matched projection.

ActionFuncLink::apply also calls funcLinkOutput. Locked-void and unlocked output-activation effects are visible here, but existing CALL outputs, unique-output LowlevelError, non-void register/stack outputs, calculated booleans, assumedOutputExtension, PIECE/SEXT/ZEXT insertion, and output aliasing are not covered.
Only scalar int8 prototype inputs are assigned. Multi-piece, join, hidden-return, indirect-storage, endian, zero-size, and assignment-error partial-state paths remain outside this fixture.
The fixture uses the locked x86-64 GCC __stdcall model but does not exercise ParamList model-rule decode, rule ordering, non-standard assignment strategies, or their error and partial-mutation paths.
Scalar int8 types do not prove Architecture-owned TypeFactory canonical identity for non-scalar, joined, hidden-return, or model-assigned datatype graphs.

runner.policy: Mode 0755 immutable-FD self-read; locked tag/tree/blob checks; dirty-oracle rejection; hash-pinned source/spec/BFD inputs; isolated base-plus-overlay snapshot; offline Cargo; raw byte diff with capture hash validation.
